name: wp-browser-id-query-param
description: [RULING A part a] Browser/platform IDs present as URL QUERY PARAMS populate the top-level payload keys deterministically in core parse (runtime findings ruling, split responsibility). Plugin evidence: BrowserIdentifiers.collect(params) reads fbp/_fbp, fbc/_fbc, ttp/_ttp, li_gc, ga_client_id (format-validated), ga_session_id, ga_session_number (clicutcl-attribution.js:859-906). Cookie-derived IDs are adapter-side behind consent and out of scope here.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling A part a): core collects query-param browser IDs; /browser adapter owns cookie-derived IDs behind the consent gate. ga_client_id is reduced to its last two numeric dot parts exactly like the plugin's parseGaClientId (:826-846).
